ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Given emf V = 3 V, external resistance R = 200 Ω, and time t = 18 s. Since internal resistance is neglected, the voltage across the resistor is 3 V. By Ohm’s law, I = V/R = 3/200 = 0.015 A. The directed charge passing through a cross-section in 18 s is Q = It = 0.015 × 18 = 0.27 C. The number of electrons passing through the cross-section is N = Q/e = 0.27/(1.6×10^-19) ≈ 1.7×10^19.
